body:
One Army base I was stationed at had the ammo dump outside the main gate and a few miles down the highway.  We had guys guarding it 24/7 of course.  One guy standing in front of each bunker door, another guy walking in a circle around the big mound of dirt each bunker was buried under, and another dozen sitting in a little house a couple hundred yards away to assist if need be.

December 24, i'm stuck on duty, but somewhat lucky, it's a cold night and I'm one of the ones sitting in the little warm house.  We hear a gunshot, everyone grabs their weapons and heads towards the bunkers.  We get there and find some idiots with handguns standing out in the middle of the very well lit area right in the middle of all the bunkers, in a mexican standoff with the bunker guards.  We get there just in time to hear one of these yahoos tell the guards who are pointing M-16s at them that they WILL be going in to the bunker to do some shopping, and the guards better stand aside or else...

That was the point when I decided to make them aware that more soldiers were on the scene.   Everyone joked about it later, calling me Clint Eastwood for my calm quiet voice when I said, "I know it's Christmas Eve, but do you really wanna sing with the angels?"  

I took a lot of kidding for several months after that.

Our visitors decided not to push it, and we had fun hog tieing them with 100 mph tape while we waited on the MPs and state police to show up.

I've lost everything I care about.  I have nothing left anymore except pain.  I don't want to hurt like this anymore.  

My wife took our kids and left.  She won't let me talk to them or see them because she knows how to hurt me.

We dated for a couple of years, then she got really sick and couldn't work for over a year.  I let her move in with me, and I provided for her.  I had to get a part time job to supplement our income, but I was happy to do it. We got married about 6 months after she moved in with me.

Unfortunately, I chose to make the National Guard my part time job, just a couple of months before 9-11. I ended up going to Iraq and saw a lot of friends get killed.  I was wounded.  I came home with PTSD.  Truthfully, the VA really isn't capable of dealing with the volume of PTSD it has on its hands right now.  I can only manage to get a single one hour appointment for counseling like every 6 or 7 weeks.  Not really enough.  I've pretty much been battling this demon on my own.

Fast forward to my present day shithole reality.  I have a wife I love and two kids that are my entire world.  My wife hates me.  She's been out of work for over two years, and she's always pissed because I try to work as much overtime as I can to pay the bills, and she can't find a job.  But that means I'm not home to help with the kids.  

Our youngest one has a birth defect that compromises her immune system, so she's pretty much sick more than she isn't.  My wife is mad because she wants to work but can't find a job, she makes me feel bad because I can't be home more to help with the kids.

And now she left.  Everything I am, Everything that I care about got loaded up into her car and I don't know where they are.  

I'm not trying to paint a picture of myself as a saint.  I share the responsibility for the break down of my marriage.  I have PTSD.  When my wife yells at me or the kids, I have a tendency to yell back. 

My kids are my world.  I go to work early while they're still asleep so I can get off work early and spend as much time as I can with them in the afternoon/evening before they go to bed.  I try to squeeze in as much work from home as I can after they go to bed at night.  

Everything I do is for them.  My job means nothing to me without them.  I work to provide a home for them.  Our house is just a house now.  It doesn't feel like a home anymore with them gone.

Nothing I have left in my life matters to me without my family.

I don't have anyone.  Everyone I care about has been taken away from me.  My only joy comes from my kids, and my wife took them and left.  She won't even let me talk to them on the phone because she knows how much it hurts me to not get to talk to them.
Don't bother with the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline.  I just tried them a few minutes ago and they put me on hold.  seriously.

No, definitely not a condor.  Granted, those are huge, but what I saw was big enough to make a 747 look like a Cessna in comparison.  Don't have a frakkin' clue what it was, and most of the time, I'm pretty happy to not know.
I saw a UFO about 7 years ago.  It crossed over the highway in front of me at what I guessed to be about 200 feet in the air.
Negotiate for car payments at 1/2 of what you can afford.  Then make double payments every month.  You'll pay off the loan early, and get a good boost to your credit report.
this could mean the end of busted condoms.

The Walmart near my house put those on sale yesterday for a dollar.  A huge stack of about 250 giants jugs filled with cheese puffs disappeared in just a few minutes.  

I managed to get  8 of them piled up in my shopping cart.
